description: Barwon Water Water Hydrants and Fire Plugs is a dataset listed in Geelong Data Exchange open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Barwon Water. Water hydrants and fire plugs within the Barwon Water utility network. This data has been prepared to be shared with external users and is licensed under Creative Commons 4.0. To maintain currency, data is republished once per month. Coverage: Geelong region, Victoria. The portal files it under City Services. Its keywords are Barwon Water, water, hydrants, fire. The portal shows 28,978 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-12-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-geelongdataexchange-com-au-portal.
